According to Box Office Mojo (as cited by IMDB), the worldwide gross is over $2 billion [d8]. After accounting for the $210 million production budget and roughly $150 million in marketing costs, the studios (20th Century Fox and Paramount Pictures) made an estimated profit of approximately $1.4 billion from the film [d2].
